articles.abstract_en: In this paper we highlight a few striking features of CEO compensation in the US from 1994 to 2020. For the purpose of measuring both the level and sensitivity of compensation, we define the latter as the year–on–year change in the portion of the executive's wealth tied to the firm. Compared to a narrower definition often adopted in the literature to measure levels, the cross-sectional distribution displays much higher skewness and variation. Each year, a sizable fraction of chief executives lose money. During the second decade of this century, the award of options kept declining, while stock grants became more plentiful. In net, the dollar value of CEOs' position in their respective company did not keep up with the growth in capitalization. This contributes to explaining why the semi-elasticity of compensation with respect shareholder wealth has declined.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们强调了1994年至2020年间美国CEO薪酬的几个显著特征。为了衡量薪酬的水平及其敏感性，我们将后者定义为高管财富中与公司挂钩部分的同比变化。与文献中常采用的衡量水平的较窄定义相比，横截面分布显示出更高的偏度和变异性。每年，相当一部分首席执行官会亏损。在本世纪的第二个十年中，期权授予持续下降，而股票授予变得更加普遍。总体而言，CEO在其各自公司中头寸的美元价值并未跟上资本化的增长。这有助于解释为什么薪酬相对于股东财富的半弹性有所下降。

articles.abstract_en: For decades credit rating agencies were viewed as trusted arbiters of creditworthiness and their ratings as important tools for managing risk. The common narrative is that the value of ratings was compromised by the evolution of the industry to a form where issuers pay for ratings. In this paper we consider both an investor-pays and an issuer-pays set-ups and show that if the investor-pays version can overcome the free-rider problem it is efficient, and otherwise leads to under-provision of information; while if the issuer-pays can force disclosure, it is efficient, but otherwise it leads to less revealing information because of the systematic distortion in revealed information along with over-investment in information. We show that in both these arrangements credit ratings have value in equilibrium and how reputation insures that, in equilibrium, ratings will reflect sound assessments of credit worthiness. We argue that regulatory reliance on ratings and the increasing importance of risk-weighted capital in prudential regulation have more likely contributed to distorted ratings than the matter of who pays for them.
articles.abstract_cn: 几十年来，信用评级机构一直被视为可信赖的信用度仲裁者，其评级被视为管理风险的重要工具。普遍的说法是，评级价值因行业演变为发行人付费模式而受到损害。在本文中，我们同时考虑投资者付费和发行人付费两种设置，并表明如果投资者付费模式能够克服搭便车问题，则是有效的，否则会导致信息供给不足；而如果发行人付费模式能够强制披露，则是有效的，否则由于所披露信息的系统性扭曲以及信息过度投资，会导致信息揭示程度降低。我们表明，在这两种安排中，信用评级在均衡中都具有价值，并且声誉如何确保在均衡中评级反映对信用度的合理评估。我们认为，监管对评级的依赖以及风险加权资本在审慎监管中日益增长的重要性，更可能是导致评级扭曲的原因，而非谁为评级付费的问题。

articles.title_en: Cross-phenomenon restrictions: Unemployment effects of layoff costs and quit turbulence
articles.title_cn: 跨现象约束：裁员成本与离职扰动的失业效应
articles.abstract_en: Cross-phenomenon restrictions associated with returns to labor mobility can inform calibrations of productivity processes in macro-labor models. We exploit how returns to labor mobility influence effects on equilibrium unemployment of changes in (a) layoff costs, and (b) distributions of skill losses coincident with quits (“quit turbulence”). Returns to labor mobility intermediate both effects. Ample labor reallocations observed across market economies that have different layoff costs imply that a turbulence explanation of trans-Atlantic unemployment experiences is robust to adding plausible quit turbulence.
articles.abstract_cn: 与劳动力流动回报相关的跨现象约束可以为宏观劳动模型中生产率过程的校准提供信息。我们利用劳动力流动回报如何影响（a）裁员成本变化和（b）与离职同时发生的技能损失分布（“离职扰动”）对均衡失业的影响。劳动力流动回报对这两种效应都起到中介作用。在具有不同裁员成本的市场经济体中所观察到的充足的劳动力重新配置表明，对跨大西洋失业经历的扰动解释在加入合理的离职扰动后仍然稳健。

articles.title_en: Labor supply when productivity keeps growing
articles.title_cn: 生产率持续增长时的劳动供给
articles.abstract_en: We examine the intensive and extensive margins of labor supply in an incomplete-markets framework where productivity keeps growing. What are, in particular, the long-run implications for who will work how much, and how the distribution of economic welfare among households will change? We insist the relative strengths of income and substitution effects to be such as to match historical and cross-country observations. That is, hours will fall toward zero as productivity and income rise, while wages per hour will keep rising and be consistent with stable income shares for labor and capital. Despite this rather drastic path toward zero hours worked, we find that few features of the distribution of outcomes in the population are affected much at all by productivity growth. In particular, the relative distribution of hours worked and of consumption will look very similar to the case without productivity growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了在不完全市场框架下生产率持续增长时劳动供给的集约边际和广延边际。特别是，长期来看，谁将工作多少以及家庭间经济福利的分配将如何变化？我们强调收入和替代效应的相对强度应与历史和国际观察相匹配。也就是说，随着生产率和收入的上升，工作时间将趋于零，而每小时工资将持续上升，并与劳动和资本的稳定收入份额保持一致。尽管工作时间趋于零的路径相当剧烈，但我们发现，生产率增长对人口中结果分布的少数特征影响甚微。特别是，工作时间与消费的相对分布将与无生产率增长的情况非常相似。

articles.title_en: Demographic change, government debt and fiscal sustainability in Japan: The impact of bond purchases by the Bank of Japan
articles.title_cn: 人口变化、政府债务与日本财政可持续性：日本银行购买债券的影响
articles.abstract_en: We reconsider the fiscal consequences of an aging population in Japan that were reported in Hansen and İmrohoroğlu (2016). That paper predicted that the net debt to GNP ratio would reach 250 percent in 2021, while the actual net debt to GNP ratio was roughly constant at about 120% from 2011 to 2019. Here we study the role played by higher tax revenues, lower spending, and lower interest rates than were assumed in the previous paper. Most importantly, we consider the role played by Japanese government bonds held by the Bank of Japan in enabling this period of debt stability. We conclude that the stable net debt to output ratio is predicted to be temporary and reach 250 percent before 2040.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了Hansen和İmrohoroğlu（2016）所报告的日本人口老龄化带来的财政后果。该论文预测，净债务与国民生产总值之比将在2021年达到250%，而实际净债务与国民生产总值之比在2011年至2019年间大致稳定在约120%。在此，我们研究了较之前论文假设更高的税收收入、更低的支出和更低的利率所发挥的作用。最重要的是，我们考虑了日本银行持有的日本政府债券在实现这一时期债务稳定中所扮演的角色。我们得出结论，稳定的净债务与产出之比预计是暂时的，并将在2040年前达到250%。
articles.abstract_snippet_en: We reconsider the fiscal consequences of an aging population in Japan that were reported in Hansen and İmrohoroğlu (2016). That paper predicted that the net debt to GNP ratio would reach 250 percent...

articles.title_en: On a lender of last resort with a central bank and a stability Fund
articles.title_cn: 论中央银行与稳定基金作为最后贷款人的作用
articles.abstract_en: We explore the complementarity between a central bank and a financial stability Fund in stabilizing sovereign debt markets. The central bank pursuing its mandate can intervene with public sector purchasing programs, buying sovereign debt in the secondary market, provided that the debt is safe. The sovereign sells its debt to private lenders, through market auctions. Furthermore, it has access to a long-term state-contingent contract with a Fund: a country-specific debt-and-insurance contract that accounts for no-default and no-over-lending constraints. The Fund needs to guarantee gross-financial-needs and no-over-lending. We show that these constraints endogenously determine the ‘optimal debt maturity’ structure that minimizes the Required Fund Capacity (RFC) to make all sovereign debt safe. However, the Fund may have limited absorption capacity and fall short of its RFC. The central bank may be able to cover the difference, in which case there is perfect complementarity and the joint institutions act as an effective ‘lender of last resort’. We calibrate our model to the Italian economy and find that with a Fund contract its ‘optimal debt maturity’ is 2.9 years with an RFC of 90% of GDP, which is above what the European Stability Mechanism (ESM) could reasonably absorb, but may be feasible with an ECB Transmission Protection Instrument (TPI) intervention. In contrast, the average maturity of Italian sovereign debt has been circa 6.2 years, with a needed absorption capacity of around 105% of GDP, which may call for a maturity restructuring to ease the activation of TPI.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了中央银行与金融稳定基金在稳定主权债务市场中的互补性。中央银行在追求其使命时，可以通过公共部门购买计划进行干预，在二级市场购买主权债务，前提是该债务是安全的。主权国家通过市场拍卖将其债务出售给私人贷款人。此外，它还可以与基金签订一项长期的国家或有合同：一项针对特定国家的债务与保险合同，该合同考虑了不违约和不超额贷款约束。基金需要保证总融资需求和不超额贷款。我们表明，这些约束内生地决定了“最优债务期限”结构，该结构最小化所需基金能力（RFC）以使所有主权债务安全。然而，基金可能吸收能力有限，无法达到其RFC。中央银行或许能够弥补差额，在这种情况下，存在完美互补性，联合机构作为有效的“最后贷款人”发挥作用。我们将模型校准到意大利经济，发现通过基金合同，其“最优债务期限”为2.9年，RFC为GDP的90%，这高于欧洲稳定机制（ESM）合理吸收的能力，但通过欧洲央行传导保护工具（TPI）干预可能是可行的。相比之下，意大利主权债务的平均期限约为6.2年，所需吸收能力约为GDP的105%，这可能需要进行期限重组以促进TPI的激活。

articles.title_en: Taxes, regulations, and the value of U.S. corporations: A reassessment
articles.title_cn: 税收、监管与美国公司价值：再评估
articles.abstract_en: This paper reassesses the conclusions of McGrattan and Prescott (2005), which derived the quantitative implications of growth theory for U.S. corporate valuations. In addition to having two more decades of data, the analysis incorporates recent changes in policies that affect corporate investments, taxes, and legal-form choice. Secular trends identified in the earlier period remain, with little change in the tangible capital-output ratio or profit share of output. Corporate valuations remain high relative to the postwar average, in line with the theoretical prediction. Critical to this prediction are the decline in effective tax rate on distributions and the rise of foreign direct investment abroad. With the recent enactment of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, corporate valuations are predicted to rise even further relative to GDP.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文重新评估了McGrattan和Prescott（2005）的结论，该研究推导了增长理论对美国公司估值的定量含义。除了拥有另外二十年的数据外，本分析还纳入了近期影响公司投资、税收和法律形式选择的政策变化。早期阶段确定的长期趋势依然存在，有形资本产出比或利润占产出的份额几乎没有变化。公司估值相对于战后平均水平仍然较高，这与理论预测一致。对这一预测至关重要是分配有效税率的下降和对外直接投资的增加。随着最近《减税与就业法案》的颁布，预计公司估值相对于GDP将进一步上升。
articles.abstract_snippet_en: This paper reassesses the conclusions of McGrattan and Prescott (2005), which derived the quantitative implications of growth theory for U.S. corporate valuations. In addition to having two more decades...

articles.title_en: The looming fiscal reckoning: Tax distortions, top earners, and revenues
articles.title_cn: 迫在眉睫的财政清算：税收扭曲、高收入者与财政收入
articles.abstract_en: How should the U.S. confront the growing revenue needs driven by higher spending requirements? We investigate the mix of potential tax increases that generate a given revenue need at the minimum welfare cost and evaluate its macroeconomic impact. We do so in the context of a life-cycle growth model that captures key aspects of the earnings and wealth distributions and the non-linear shape of taxes and transfers in place. Our findings show that a proportional consumption tax combined with a lump-sum transfer to all households and a reduction in income tax progressivity consistently emerges as the best alternative to minimize welfare costs associated with a given increase in revenue. A 30% long-run increase in Federal tax revenue requires a consumption tax rate of 27.8%, a transfer of about 12% of mean household income to all households, and a reduction of top marginal income tax rates of more than 5 percentage points—output declines by 7.9% in the long run. While transfers are substantial, smaller transfers can accomplish most of the reduction in welfare costs. We find no role for wealth taxes in increasing revenues or minimizing welfare costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国应如何应对由更高支出需求驱动的日益增长的财政收入需求？我们研究了在最小福利成本下产生给定财政收入需求的潜在增税组合，并评估其宏观经济影响。我们在一个生命周期增长模型框架下进行分析，该模型捕捉了收入与财富分配的关键特征以及现行税收和转移支付的非线性形态。我们的研究结果表明，比例消费税结合对所有家庭的一次性转移支付以及降低所得税累进性，始终是使与给定财政收入增加相关的福利成本最小化的最佳选择。联邦税收收入长期增加30%需要消费税率为27.8%，向所有家庭转移约平均家庭收入的12%，并将最高边际所得税率降低超过5个百分点——长期产出下降7.9%。虽然转移支付规模可观，但较小的转移支付也能实现福利成本的大部分降低。我们发现财富税在增加财政收入或最小化福利成本方面没有作用。

articles.title_en: The expansion of varieties in the new age of advertising
articles.title_cn: 广告新时代中的品种扩张
articles.abstract_en: The last decades have seen large improvements in digital advertising technology that allowed firms to target better specific consumer tastes. This research studies the relationship between digital advertising, the rise of varieties, and economic welfare. A model of advertising and varieties is developed, where firms choose the intensity of digital ads directed at specific consumers as well as traditional ads that are undirected. The calibrated model shows that improvements in digital advertising have driven the rise in varieties over time. Empirical evidence is presented using detailed micro data on firms' products and advertising choices since 1995. Causal analysis using exogenous variation in consumers' differential access to the internet supports the suggested mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去几十年，数字广告技术取得了巨大进步，使企业能够更好地针对特定消费者的品味。本研究探讨了数字广告、品种增加与经济福利之间的关系。我们建立了一个广告与品种模型，其中企业选择针对特定消费者的数字广告强度以及无针对性的传统广告。校准模型表明，数字广告的改进推动了品种随时间增加。利用自1995年以来关于企业产品和广告选择的详细微观数据，提供了实证证据。利用消费者互联网接入差异的外生变化进行的因果分析支持了所提出的机制。

articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes an economy in which agents face related problems and invest in parameter information that they share. The N-player game generates growth via statistical learning alone. The equilibrium growth rate rises with agents' risk aversion via precautionary saving. Research entails a free riding problem, but the scale effect dominates and growth rises with the number of agents.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了一个经济体，其中代理人面临相关问题，并投资于他们共享的参数信息。这个N人博弈仅通过统计学习就产生了增长。均衡增长率随着代理人的风险厌恶程度通过预防性储蓄而上升。研究涉及搭便车问题，但规模效应占主导地位，增长随着代理人数量而上升。

articles.title_en: More unequal we stand? Inequality dynamics in the United States, 1967–2021
articles.title_cn: 我们是否更加不平等？美国的不平等动态，1967-2021
articles.abstract_en: Heathcote et al. (2010) conducted an empirical analysis of several dimensions of inequality in the United States over the years 1967-2006, using publicly-available survey data. This paper expands the analysis, and extends it to 2021. We find that since the early 2000s, the college wage premium has stopped growing, and the race wage gap has stalled. However, the gender wage gap has kept shrinking. Both individual- and household-level income inequality have continued to rise at the top, while the cyclical component of inequality dominates dynamics below the median. Inequality in consumption expenditures has remained remarkably stable over time. Income pooling within the family and redistribution by the government have enormous impacts on the dynamics of household-level inequality, with the role of the family diminishing and that of the government growing over time. In particular, largely due to generous government transfers, the COVID recession has been the first downturn in fifty years in which inequality in disposable income and consumption actually declined.
articles.abstract_cn: Heathcote等人（2010）利用公开可得的调查数据，对美国在1967-2006年间不平等的多个维度进行了实证分析。本文扩展了这一分析，并将其延伸至2021年。我们发现，自2000年代初以来，大学工资溢价已停止增长，种族工资差距停滞不前。然而，性别工资差距持续缩小。个人和家庭层面的收入不平等在顶端持续上升，而不平等的周期性成分主导了中位数以下的动态。消费支出的不平等随时间保持显著稳定。家庭内部的收入汇集和政府的再分配对家庭层面不平等的动态产生巨大影响，其中家庭的作用逐渐减弱，而政府的作用随时间增强。特别是，由于慷慨的政府转移支付，新冠疫情衰退成为五十年来首次可支配收入和消费不平等实际下降的经济衰退。

articles.title_en: Accounting for the duality of the Italian economy
articles.title_cn: 解释意大利经济的二元性
articles.abstract_en: After 162 years of political unification, Italy still displays large regional economic differences. In 2019, the per capita GDP of Lombardia was 39,700 euros, but Calabria's per capita GDP was only 17,300 euros. We build a two-region, two-sector model of the Italian economy to measure the wedges that could account for the differences in aggregate variables between the North and the South. We find that the largest driver of the regional disparity in per capita output is the difference in total factor productivity, followed by fiscal redistribution. These two factors, together, account for more than 70 percent of the output disparity between the North and the South.
articles.abstract_cn: 在政治统一162年后，意大利仍然显示出巨大的区域经济差异。2019年，伦巴第的人均GDP为39,700欧元，而卡拉布里亚的人均GDP仅为17,300欧元。我们构建了一个两区域、两部门的意大利经济模型，以衡量能够解释北方和南方之间总体变量差异的楔子。我们发现，人均产出区域差异的最大驱动因素是全要素生产率的差异，其次是财政再分配。这两个因素合计解释了北方和南方之间产出差异的70%以上。

excluded_items.title_en: Introduction to the special issue in memory of Thomas F. Cooley
